name: Lower Mortlock
region: Lower Mortlocks (Satawan, Té, Lukunosh, Oneop), Chuuk State
notes: Glottolog 5.4 dialect of Mortlockese (lowe1410), coordinates as Glottolog gives them. Odango (2015: 23-24) groups the Mortlocks as Upper, Mid and Lower, with Lukunosh in the Lower Mortlocks, and describes Mortlockese as 'an array of at least 11 different dialects'. A node for the Pakin Lukunosh geolect; no rows of its own.

name: Pakin Lukunosh Mortlockese
region: Pakin Atoll, Pohnpei State (settled from Lukunosh, Lower Mortlocks)
orthography_note: IPA, as Odango (2015) writes all examples (p. 95); his working orthography (Figures 15, 17) is in source_symbol: ch, sh, ng; á é ó ú for æ ɞ ɔ ʉ; doubled letters for geminates and long vowels.
notes: 'The Pakin geolect of the Lukunosh dialect of Mortlockese' (Odango 2015: abstract), spoken on Pakin Atoll in Pohnpei State. Most of the description holds for Mortlockese as a whole, 'largely—but not entirely' (p. 95). Glottolog has no code for the geolect or for Lukunosh: it shares the code of the Lower Mortlock dialect (lowe1410). Coordinates are those of the dialect. Shown by its sourced inventory; no correspondence rows.
